verses.english: Linked Discourses 22.64
7. The Perfected Ones
Conceiving
At Sāvatthī.

verses.pali: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu …pe… ekamantaṁ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Then a mendicant went up to the Buddha … and asked him,

verses.pali: “sādhu me, bhante, bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṁ desetu …pe… ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyan”ti.
verses.english: “Sir, may the Buddha please teach me Dhamma in brief. When I’ve heard it, I’ll live alone, withdrawn, diligent, keen, and resolute.”
“When you conceive, mendicant, you’re bound by Māra.
Not conceiving, you’re free from the Wicked One.”
“Understood, Blessed One! Understood, Holy One!”

verses.pali: “Yathā kathaṁ pana tvaṁ, bhikkhu, mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṁ ājānāsī”ti?
verses.english: “But how do you see the detailed meaning of my brief statement?”
“Sir, when you conceive form you’re bound by Māra.
Not conceiving, you’re free from the Wicked One.
When you conceive feeling …
perception …
choices …
consciousness, you’re bound by Māra.
Not conceiving, you’re free from the Wicked One.

verses.pali: Imassa khvāhaṁ, bhante, bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṁ vitthārena atthaṁ ājānāmī”ti.
verses.english: That’s how I understand the detailed meaning of the Buddha’s brief statement.”
“Good, good, mendicant!

verses.pali: Sādhu kho tvaṁ, bhikkhu, mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṁ ājānāsi.
verses.english: It’s good that you understand the detailed meaning of what I’ve said in brief like this.

verses.pali: Rūpaṁ kho, bhikkhu, maññamāno baddho mārassa;
verses.english: When you conceive form you’re bound by Māra.
Not conceiving, you’re free from the Wicked One.
When you conceive feeling …
perception …
choices …
consciousness, you’re bound by Māra.
Not conceiving, you’re free from the Wicked One.

verses.pali: Imassa kho, bhikkhu, mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṁ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabbo”ti …pe…
verses.english: This is how to understand the detailed meaning of what I said in brief.” …

verses.pali: aññataro ca pana so bhikkhu arahataṁ ahosīti.
verses.english: And that mendicant became one of the perfected.
